title: Orders
intro: Accept or decline new orders before their cutoff, mark them ready on market day, and complete them when the customer has paid.

placed.title: Nothing waiting for you
placed.text: New pre-orders land here until 12 hours before their slot.

accepted.title: No accepted orders
accepted.text: Orders you accept wait here until you mark them ready.

ready.title: Nothing ready yet
ready.text: Mark an accepted order ready once it is packed for the stall.

completed.title: No completed orders
completed.text: An order completes when the customer collects and pays at the stall.

declined.title: No declined orders
declined.text: Orders you turn down are listed here with the reason.

cancelled.title: No cancelled orders
cancelled.text: Customers can cancel until the cutoff (D-05).

auditNote: Status changes are recorded with the time and who made them (FR-038). A change in the wrong order is refused (D-04).

decline.title: Decline order {{code}}?
decline.text: The customer is told right away and the items go back to your stock.

complete.title: Mark {{code}} as completed?
complete.text: Do this after the customer has collected the order and paid at the stall. Completed orders count towards your revenue and unlock the customer's review.
complete.auto: Orders still marked Ready are completed automatically 24 hours after the pickup date (D-03).
